headline: Broad networked CRM agent paired with note-retrieval agent creates default data-leakage and cascading-error risk; prompt injection and write-conflict risks are lower.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Aci can ingest external content via APIs/MCP and Khoj can read indexed documents, so a manual or file-based bridge could carry malicious instructions. However, no shared channel is documented and Khoj has no clipboard or stdin/stdout surface, so the pathway is not default. The interaction is plausible but limited.
conditions: IF the operator copies Aci-generated content into Khoj notes or indexed files
IF Aci is configured to fetch untrusted web or email content that Khoj later indexes
mitigations: Restrict Aci outputs to structured fields only
Do not index raw Aci transcripts in Khoj
Add a manual review step before importing content
Tag imported files as untrusted in Khoj
requires-engineering: add provenance labels to indexed documents

B_data_leakage.rationale: Aci touches CRM, email, calendar, and support data and has broad network egress; Khoj reads indexed personal notes/files and also has broad egress. If Aci outputs sensitive records into files or notes that Khoj indexes, both agents can expose the same data class in default workflows. The shared-workspace path is not explicit, so uncertainty keeps this at medium rather than high.
conditions: IF Aci exports CRM/email/support content into files or notes indexed by Khoj
IF Khoj is connected to a cloud or configured search provider that receives indexed content
mitigations: Exclude CRM and email exports from Khoj indexing
Use separate storage locations for Aci and Khoj
Disable cloud search providers for sensitive collections
Review indexed folders daily for sensitive records
requires-engineering: enforce per-source access controls

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Aci supports multiple instances and can call external APIs, while Khoj supports multiple instances with shared index across clients. But Aci has no filesystem write and Khoj cannot write files or modify git state, so direct write-write conflict is absent. The remaining overlap is mostly read/egress coordination, which is lower risk.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same mutable external API resource
IF the operator uses a shared CRM or notes backend with optimistic updates
mitigations: Assign separate API credentials per agent
Avoid concurrent edits to the same record set
Schedule Aci and Khoj jobs at different times
Use read-only access for Khoj where possible
requires-engineering: add locking around shared backends

D_cascading_error.rationale: Aci can generate CRM, email, and research outputs that Khoj may retrieve and present as authoritative notes. Khoj is a retrieval-focused conversational agent, so if its indexed content comes from Aci without verification, errors can cascade into downstream decisions. The pair lacks a documented verification boundary, so the default risk is material.
conditions: IF Khoj indexes Aci-generated summaries or action items
IF users rely on Khoj answers without checking the original CRM or email source
mitigations: Mark Aci-generated notes as unverified
Require source links in Khoj answers
Keep action items separate from raw retrieval corpora
Spot-check high-impact summaries before use
requires-engineering: add citation enforcement in retrieval prompts

E_compliance.rationale: Aci handles email, CRM, calendar, and support data, while Khoj indexes personal notes/files and may use cloud or self-hosted servers. That creates a plausible retention and residency mismatch if Aci exports regulated customer data into Khoj’s index or cloud search. The profiles do not prove a specific jurisdiction breach, so medium is appropriate.
conditions: IF customer support or CRM data is exported from Aci into Khoj-managed storage
IF Khoj is deployed with cloud search or retention settings longer than the source system
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of Khoj indexes
Set shorter retention on Khoj collections containing exports
Document data-flow boundaries between systems
Review self-hosted vs cloud deployment settings
requires-engineering: align retention and deletion workflows
